# Aspect model example payloads

The JSON files in this directory are the generated example payloads (`gen/<Aspect>.json`) from
[eclipse-tractusx/sldt-semantic-models](https://github.com/eclipse-tractusx/sldt-semantic-models)
at commit `ff04cc7c4915eb29ed2b5656d9e7d45b31079c04`, named `<namespace>-<version>.json`.

They are licensed under [CC-BY-4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode)
by the Eclipse Tractus-X contributors and are used unmodified.
